name: Kotori Love Ex P
source:
Kotori Love Ex P is comprised of three parts: Kotori LOVE (Kotori's stories from D.C.P.C., D.C.W.S., D.C.A.S., and C.D.C.D.), Kotori Extasy! (18+ port of PS2 D.C.I.F.) and Kotori Plus!. The last part is a brand new story focusing on Junichi and Kotori’s life as newly-weds.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/04/02/april-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
《Kotori Love Ex P》由三个部分组成：《Kotori LOVE》（收录小鸟在《D.C.P.C.》《D.C.W.S.》《D.C.A.S.》和《C.D.C.D.》中的故事）、《Kotori Extasy!》（PS2版《D.C.I.F.》的18+移植版），以及《Kotori Plus!》。最后一部分是全新故事，聚焦纯一与小鸟的新婚生活。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/04/02/april-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
